description: UI anti-patterns the product-design pack flags on write (warn) while a workstream in projects/ declares pack: product-design. If one keeps coming back, promote a stricter version to an instinct with enforce: block.

bans.rule: No gradient text — it fails contrast checks and reads as decoration, not hierarchy.
No glassmorphism panels — blurred translucency costs legibility and contrast.
Keep corner radii at 16px or less (pills excepted) — oversized radii make every surface look like the same template.
No accent side-stripes on cards — mark importance with hierarchy, not decoration.
Don't track text wider than 0.15em — it slows reading; use weight or size for emphasis.
